note: Seed lists are frozen once results exist; add a new suite instead of editing one. birth 'fixed' is the better-borg-c cohort input (Human Warrior, default point buy); 'random' lets the seeded game choose race and class; 'assigned' gives each seed a race and class from the suite's characters (classes dealt in turn, races cycled per round). Rule suites (seed_rule sha256-v1) draw deterministic, well-spread 31-bit seeds and never reuse a seed of any other suite. role: 'pilot' (sizing and exploration), 'development' (screening and choosing what to confirm), 'confirmation' (prespecified tests only), 'sealed' (untouched until the owner opens it for a final claim).
